About FYRNEX

Give us the job. Forget about fire safety.

FYRNEX is a Kolkata-based fire protection & security company. Our goal is simple: your premises stay compliant, protected and audit-ready while we handle the inspection, servicing, renewals and paperwork. One call, and fire safety stops being your problem.

Why FYRNEX

Licensed & verifiable

KMC-enlisted contractor (C.E. 002438113036), GST-registered and Udyam MSME. Our certificates are published openly in the Standards section below — we are happy to be checked.

One team owns the whole job

Inspection, supply, servicing and documentation are handled by the same Fyrnex people from first visit to renewal — no subcontractor roulette, no “who did we send last time?”.

Marked parts, no surprises

IS 2190 servicing with ISI/BIS-marked equipment and extinguishers only. If a part is ever replaced, it is itemised on your job sheet in writing.

Paperwork that survives audits

Stickers, certificates and a complete service history for your site — kept current and handed over in one clean file. Renewal dates are tracked, and we call you before they are due.

Support that actually answers

Call or WhatsApp and you reach someone who knows your site — not a call centre. And if anything is ever off, we come back. Disappearing after installation is not how we work.

Our Work Procedure

1

Inspect

We visit, assess the site and existing equipment — you don't need to prepare anything.

2

Recommend

We tell you exactly what's needed and why — no upselling, no jargon.

3

Service

We supply, install or service everything ourselves, on schedule.

4

Document

We hand you complete, audit-ready records — nothing for you to chase.

5

Follow up

We track your renewal dates and reach out first, before they're due.
